faq.subtitle: Compatibility, bans and access—no vague promises.

items.q: Where do I check if the loader is current?
items.a: Read cheatsapexlegends.com after a Javelin update. A banner from yesterday is not a current build. Leave the loader closed until the page matches this client.

items.q: A big Apex Legends update just dropped. When do I open the loader?
items.a: Read the status page after that client build, and after every hotfix, before you launch. A saved config from an older build is not a current check. A ban is still possible.
items.aHtml: Read the status page after that client build, and after every hotfix, before you launch. A saved config from an older build is not a current check. A ban is still possible.

items.q: Will a game patch change the loader menu overnight?
items.a: Season updates can change maps and balance. Read the status note after each client or Javelin update before you assume a saved preset still matches.
items.aHtml: Season updates can change maps and balance. Read the status page after each client or Javelin update before you assume a saved preset still matches.

items.q: What happens after I buy?
items.a: Checkout opens the portal with the loader for the product you paid for. Save a config after you tune it. HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot stay on.

items.q: Can I get banned?
items.a: Yes. EA Javelin Anticheat can act on the account. Nothing on this site is a guarantee that a session stays clean.

items.q: What is an HWID flag, and does the cheat key fix it?
items.a: A hardware flag follows the PC. New accounts can fail on that machine and work on another. That is the HWID Spoofer, sold separately. It does not undo an account-only restriction, and lifetime on the menu does not include it.

items.q: Which PCs are supported?
items.a: Windows 10 and 11 with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on. macOS and Linux are not supported.

items.q: Can I move a key to another PC?
items.a: Open support with the order email. A machine that fails new accounts is an HWID Spoofer purchase, not a free move of the cheat key.

items.q: What is for sale?
items.a: the menu and the HWID Spoofer are listed on the products page. The menu is $35 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. They are separate checkouts.

items.q: Does $150 lifetime include the spoofer?
items.a: No. Lifetime on the menu is that product only. The HWID spoofer is a separate key with its own $50 and $150 plans. A shorter plan does not promise a credit toward lifetime.

items.q: What does Player ESP show?
items.a: Player ESP draws boxes, labels, and distance readouts on enemies. Pair it with Health Bar and Weapon ESP, then lower Max Distance if the screen feels crowded.

items.q: How do I tune Advanced Aimbot?
items.a: Start with a small FOV, moderate smoothing, and Visible Check on. Raise stickiness only after a few unranked matches. Save the preset under configs when it feels stable.

items.q: What does Loot ESP mark?
items.a: Loot ESP highlights bins, death boxes, and care packages when those toggles are on. Use tier filters so only the loot you care about stays on screen.

items.q: What does Stream Proof do?
items.a: Stream Proof keeps overlays and the menu off typical capture tools while you still see them locally. It does not remove ban risk from Javelin or from posting clips.

items.q: What does No Recoil change?
items.a: No Recoil reduces vertical kick while the option is enabled. Heavy recoil patterns may still need short bursts at range.

items.q: What does EA Javelin Bypass mean here?
items.a: It means this build is checked against EA Javelin Anticheat on the status page before release. GREEN means load. RED means wait. It is not a promise that a match stays clean.

items.q: Does Weapon ESP show what opponents are holding?
items.a: Yes. Weapon ESP lists the weapon name on players when the toggle is on. Turn it off if you only care about boxes and distance.

items.q: How are Box ESP and Skeleton ESP different?
items.a: Box ESP draws a corner box on the player model. Skeleton ESP draws bone lines for posture and peek direction. Many players run both with Distance ESP.

items.q: Where do I save settings after tuning?
items.a: Use create, save, and load config in the menu after you set aim, visuals, and loot filters. Reload that file after a patch instead of copying old slider values from a guide.

items.q: Is this a DMA card?
items.a: No. The menu is a Windows loader from checkout. A DMA device is a different product and is not what this key delivers.

items.q: When is the HWID spoofer the right buy?
items.a: Use HWID Spoofer when a new account fails on one PC and works on another. It does not fix an account-only restriction on the same machine.

items.q: Are blog guides official product documentation?
items.a: Articles explain workflows and link to the menu. The feature list on that page is the checkout source of truth.

items.q: Need help applying this guide?
items.a: Open support with your order email and the article title. Include the exact loader text if something fails.

items.q: Will settings in this article work next patch?
items.a: Re-check after every Javelin update. Reload a saved config instead of copying old slider values from a post.

items.q: Which plan should I start with?
items.a: Start with the 31-day key if you want to try one product before paying once. The menu is $35 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. A shorter plan does not include a credit toward lifetime, and a lifetime key on one product does not include the others.

items.q: Can I upgrade a 31-day key to lifetime?
items.a: There is no automatic upgrade. Lifetime is a separate checkout on the same product. The $35 or $50 you already paid is not credited toward the $150 lifetime price.

items.q: What happens when a plan expires?
items.a: A 31-day key stops when that period ends. Buy another 31-day key or a lifetime key on that same product to keep access. Lifetime does not renew. An expired key does not move to a different product.

items.q: How do support and refunds work?
items.a: Open support with your order email. Sales are final once checkout completes. Change-of-mind purchases, account bans, and launches while the status page is not current are not refunded. A fix or refund is only when we confirm a fault on our side. The rules are in the terms.

Read the label after the patch before you launch.

updates.title: Season 31 client changes
updates.summary: Season 31 added Strongholds (capturable loot bunkers), Akimbo Wingman on heavy ammo, a Crypto rework with a 360-degree drone scan, and pre-match Legend bans in Diamond and above. New modes and weapons move on-screen labels. Re-read this page after the client update, then check one overlay before you queue.

updates.summary: Respawn replaced Easy Anti-Cheat on PC with EA Javelin Anticheat. The client targets kernel-level tools and other third-party software. This menu is not an easy bypass.
